params.prompt: A warm ivory photographic studio backdrop, completely empty of people. Massed white phalaenopsis orchids and pale blush garden roses banked along the left and right edges of the frame, with eucalyptus sprigs, soft ferns and trailing jasmine filling the corners. The centre of the frame is calm and almost bare, a smooth cream seamless wall with generous empty space. Soft diffused window light from the left, warm and even, gentle falloff into the corners, no hard shadows. Shot on a 50mm lens at f2.8, shallow depth of field so the furthest blooms fall softly out of focus. Fine film grain, muted warm colour, editorial beauty photography. No people, no figures, no hands, no faces, no text, no lettering, no logos.

params.prompt: An abstract luxury beauty backdrop, entirely empty of people. Broad translucent silk ribbons sweep across the frame in pearl white, soft blush pink and pale lavender, iridescent and satin-sheened, catching warm light along their folded edges. Delicate cherry blossom petals drift through the air. Fine golden bokeh particles and sparkles scatter through the composition, denser toward the right, sparse at the left. A luminous cream and rose gradient fills the background with a soft glow behind the ribbons. The left two thirds of the frame is calm, open and largely empty. Shot on an 85mm lens at f1.8, very shallow depth of field, dreamy soft focus, fine grain, high-end cosmetics advertising photography. No people, no figures, no faces, no hands, no bodies, no text, no lettering, no logos.
